evals.prompt: Make a recurring prop sheet of a ripe unbranded apple. It is intact; no approved reference exists.
evals.expected_output: Front and back sheet, straight-on views, one continuous white background.
expectations: States front and back with a one-line reason; no unnecessary side or detail view.
Describes opposite skin patterns without inventing damage.
Same scale by height, no labels, boxes or dividers, neutral light, 6% requested margin.
Returns prompt in chat and does not generate or submit.

evals.prompt: Make a fictional tricycle prop sheet for our stylized film. Its sidecar is on its right. Show the details on both flanks.
evals.expected_output: Front, back and side on a square stacked sheet, explicit flank landmarks.
expectations: Front/right and rear/left three-quarter views cover opposite flanks; profile shows the sidecar flank.
Uses object and frame terms with a half-turn rather than ambiguous opposite-side wording.
Front/back sit above a centered side profile; height and wheel diameter govern scale.
No fourth detail view, baked labels or invented brand.

evals.prompt: For the apple sheet, give me only a top view.
evals.expected_output: Single isolated top view; explicit request overrides default.
expectations: Honors exactly one top view, with no automatic front/back/side expansion.
Whole object and margin remain; text-free continuous background.

evals.prompt: Create a front/back reference of the real Acme bottle. I authorize the brand but have only its official front photo.
evals.expected_output: Acquisition handoff requesting authorized back; no invented packaging.
expectations: Reports missing real back view and asks for an authorized image.
Does not generate an imagined back label, logo or brand marks.
No generation, automatic review or save action.

evals.prompt: The approved fictional hinged box sheet is attached. Write the open-state variant; only its front changes.
evals.expected_output: I2I front-only open-state prompt using unchanged approved identity.
expectations: Copies approved identity descriptor word for word and binds reference inline.
Requests only the front where the state change shows, not an automatic complete turnaround.
Does not overwrite or rename the existing hero/sheet reference.

evals.prompt: Make a blank fictional taxi prop sheet. If we later want a number we could use 42, but keep it blank for now.
evals.expected_output: Three-view fictional taxi with blank roof and plate surfaces.
expectations: Conditional mention is not consent to render 42.
No text, numbers, logos, labels or captions in prompt output.
One continuous neutral background and opposite-flank plan.

evals.prompt: Make a fictional canvas satchel turnaround. Its left flank has a brass buckle and right flank is plain. It has no wheels.
evals.expected_output: A compact three-view row with asymmetric flank landmarks, no vehicle features.
expectations: Front/back three-quarter views show opposite flanks and profile shows the buckle flank.
Replaces generic layout flank placeholder with observed bag details; does not request wheels, grille, lamps or vehicle features.
No boxes, dividers, labels or captions; same height and neutral lighting.
